stories.title: Rescuers in Nepal find two more people alive after flash flood disaster
stories.summary: Chinese man at Trishuli hydropower project and Nepali woman in Nuwakot found 10 days into rescue operation Emergency responders have rescued a Chinese man and a Nepali woman in two separate operations as authorities continued to search for thousands of people missing 10 days after massive floods hit Nepal. The Nepali military said on Saturday a joint team comprising personnel from its army and South Korean disaster experts rescued the man from a 225-metre (740ft) tunnel in the Upper Trishuli-1 hydropower project, and that he was undergoing a health assessment. Pictures showed him being evacuated by helicopter after being carried out of the tunnel. Continue reading...

opening: The US military said it had struck and destroyed three oil tankers linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps after American warships came under Iranian fire.

"Following Iran’s failed attacks, CENTCOM permanently disabled the IRGC crude oil carriers M/T Downy off the coast of Kharg Island and M/T Stark 1 near Jask," Central Command (CENTCOM) said in a statement on X.

in the Gulf of Oman, striking the vessel in multiple critical locations to render it inoperable after the crew was directed to abandon ship," it continued.
Video released by Centcom sh.
“We will not hesitate to defend American forces, and if necessary, destroy Iran’s limited and exposed oil fleet," CENTCOM commander Admiral Brad Cooper said in a statement.

The US military said on Saturday that its forces had hit and destroyed three Iranian oil tankers after the Iranian Revolutionary Guards Corps fired ballistic missiles towards two navy warships that were patrolling the region.

US Central Command (CENTCOM) said in a statement that a US aircraft carrier and a destroyer ship had "successfully evaded multiple unprovoked Iranian attacks" and that no American personnel were hurt.

"American forces also completely destroyed the unladen crude oil carrier M/T Kylo (also known as the 'Noxen') in the Gulf of Oman, striking the vessel in multiple critical locations to render it inoperable after the crew was directed to abandon ship," it added.

Admiral Brad Cooper, the commander of CENTCOM, said the message to the IRGC was "clear": "If you shoot at two of our ships, we will impose an even higher economic cost —taking out three of yours." “We will not hesitate to defend American forces, and if necessary, destroy Iran’s limited and exposed oil fleet," he added.
Iranian media outlets had earlier reported that an Iranian oil tanker had been struck by US forces near Kharg Island on Saturday morning, close to the Strait of Hormuz.
Multiple explosions were heard and the tanker was said to have been evacuated, with no casualties reported at the time, according to the same initial reports.
It comes a day after Tehran reportedly launched anti-ship missiles against vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iranian media did not provide details as to the targets nor any damage inflicted in the alleged attacks.

Conflict between the two nations resumed last Sunday after US forces carried out strikes on Iranian rocket launchers in the Strait, a strategic energy transit chokepoint that has been at the centre of negotiations between Washington and Tehran since the Iran war began in late February.

stories.title: Masked anti-immigration protesters disrupt UK's Dover port
stories.summary: Dozens of masked anti-immigration protesters blocked roads leading to Britain’s busiest ferry port on Saturday, clogging traffic and disrupting travellers and cargo vehicles heading for France. The UK government condemned the action, saying it went beyond peaceful protest. The Port of Dover said Saturday morning that all traffic in and out was "stopped due to an ongoing public order incident," and police said they were “engaging with the protesters.” Video posted on social media showed several dozen men in black, their faces covered, standing across a major road near the port. One clip showed demonstrators linking arms across a main road and shouting “stop the boats.” Chris Vinson, a Conservative Party local councilor, said the protest appeared to be “illegal migration-related.” “I’m not aware that there’s been any violence, although clearly, having the path of your vehicle blocked by men wearing black paramilitary gear and balaclavas is extremely intimidating,” he said. The Labour Party government said “the right to peaceful protest is fundamental to our democracy, but we condemn the behaviour in Dover and the travel disruption it has caused.” The National Highways agency said the protest blocked all routes to the port and caused a 6.4km traffic jam. Police were later filmed following protesters towards Dover's railway station. P&O Ferries said just before midday that “access to the Port of Dover has now been restored.” P&O, which runs services between Dover and Calais in France, said passengers who missed their ferry would be offered the next available crossing.

stories.title: People see special military operation’s task in suppressing Nazism — Lavrov
stories.summary: "The majority of those I've spoken with view the special military operation as another task to suppress Nazism," he said
article_sentences: MOSCOW, September 5.

The Russian people view the special military operation’s a task in suppressing Nazism, which is being revived in Ukraine in a concentrated form, Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov at a meeting between Russian President Vladimir Putin and the top five members of the United Russia party's election list.
"The way I see it, the majority of those I've spoken with view the special military operation as another task to suppress Nazism.
Our great ancestors defeated Nazism, but its metastases are now spreading throughout Europe, and in Ukraine, in a concentrated form, they are simply reviving this misanthropic ideology," Lavrov.

stories.title: AI is merely tool in judge’s hands — Russian Supreme Court’s chief
stories.summary: He stressed that artificial intelligence, digital platforms, and big data "are powerful tools that we must use to serve this goal, without allowing them to replace it."
article_sentences: NEW DELHI, September 5.

Artificial intelligence is a tool in the hands of a judge - it is neither an agent of justice nor a judge itself, Igor Krasnov, Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Russia, said while speaking about the ethical principles governing the use of AI in the judiciary.

"I am convinced that artificial intelligence is a tool in the hands of a judge, an assistant, but not an agent of justice, and certainly not a judge," Krasnov said at the BRICS Supreme Court Chief Justices Forum.

"Deciding a case, evaluating evidence, establishing the truth, and applying the law are acts of human judgment grounded in law and conscience, as well as the principles of independence, fairness, and impartiality, and informed by professional experience - not probability."
He stressed that artificial intelligence, digital platforms, and big data "are powerful tools that we must use to serve this goal, without allowing them to replace it.".

stories.title: Process of strengthening Russia must be continuous — Putin
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin expressed his pre-election wishes at a meeting with the top five members of the United Russia election list
article_sentences: MOSCOW, September 5.
Russian President Vladimir Putin expressed his pre-election wishes at a meeting with the top five members of the United Russia election list.
According to the head of state, the process of strengthening Russia must be continuous and sustainable.

"We must, without any doubt, strengthen the domestic political situation and the stability of Russian statehood, despite any difficulties, despite any threats that constantly arise from outside, and follow the path of strengthening Russia in accordance with the fundamental law of the Russian state, the Constitution," Putin said.

"We must form government bodies, including representative bodies and parliament, so that decisions are made in a timely manner in accordance with the law, so that issues of a social nature, economic development, and support for people on the line of contact are resolved promptly, so that Russia grows stronger, so that this process is continuous and sustainable," he said.

stories.title: Fans display Russian flags at figure skating tournament in Japan
stories.summary: Vladislav Dikidzhi won the men's singles, Yevgeny Semenenko placed third
article_sentences: TOKYO, September 5.
Fans displayed Russian flags during the awards ceremony for the winners of the Kinoshita Group Cup international tournament in Tokyo, a TASS correspondent reports from the event.
Vladislav Dikidzhi won the men's singles.
Yevgeny Semenenko placed third.
Several fans waved Russian flags during the awards ceremony.
The flag of individual neutral athletes, which is listed in the infographic next to the names of Russians and Belarusians, was also displayed in the stands.
